# Voxa

> Open augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) app: a Next.js board app, an Expo mobile app and a Hono API in one pnpm + Turborepo monorepo (Node 22). Spanish first (es-MX), also English and French. Apache-2.0; the vendored Mulberry Symbols are CC BY-SA 4.0. Public repository: operational detail and commercial research live in MADFAM's private operations repository, not here. This file indexes the repository; the landing host serves its own product-facing `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` (built in `apps/web/src/lib/crawling.ts`).

## Read first

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): canonical agent instructions: layout, commands, tests, numbered invariants, guards, how a change ships, related contracts, and "Pending work and known gaps", the single prioritized backlog. `CLAUDE.md` points there.
- [docs/capabilities.md](./docs/capabilities.md): what ships today, per capability, with status (shipped / partial / not yet) and the PR and tests behind it.
- [README.md](./README.md): product overview, quick start, architecture sketch, environments.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md): PR checklist (accessibility, clinical accuracy, truthful public text).

## Code map

- `apps/api/src/app.ts`: Hono app; middleware order on `/v1/*` (address rate limit, body limits, auth-failure limit, `teamAuth`, user rate limit); routes under `/v1/*`, `/health`, `/health/ready`, WebSocket `/v1/ws`; `app.onError` scrubs database errors.
- `apps/api/src/index.ts`: startup (store, migrations under an advisory lock, sync hub, utterance-retention timer), fail-closed without `DATABASE_URL` in production, graceful shutdown.
- `apps/api/src/db/`: `client.ts` (`getSharedDb()`, one pool per process), `startup-retry.ts`, `schema.ts`; migrations in `apps/api/drizzle/migrations/` (`0000`–`0007`, `meta/_journal.json`, snapshots).
- `apps/api/src/store/`: PostgreSQL store (compare-and-set writes, scoped queries) and the atomic JSON file store; `board-import.ts` (imports create new boards).
- `apps/api/src/lib/`: `janua.ts` (JWKS verification), `board-access.ts` (roles and org scope), `entitlement.ts` (`voxa_tier` claim), `consents.ts` and `utterance-retention.ts`, `selva.ts` (optional model gateway, off), `media-store.ts` and `media-sniff.ts`, `build-info.ts`.
- `apps/api/src/middleware/`: rate limits, body limits, security headers, `teamAuth`. `apps/api/src/ws/`: sync hub (local or Redis).
- `apps/web/src/components/`: board screen, editor, settings, voice settings, first-run setup, landing and demo. `apps/web/src/lib/`: speech (`play-button-speech.ts`, `speech-voices.ts`), communicator settings, consent, crawling files, media proxy URLs. `apps/web/public/sw.js`: service worker (plain JavaScript).
- `packages/core` (board model, templates, core sizes), `packages/obf` (OBF 0.1, schemas), `packages/import-adapters` (beta), `packages/vocabulary` (motor plan, Spanish morphology), `packages/symbols` (Mulberry index and search), `packages/access` (scan machine, switches, dwell, keyguard), `packages/sync`, `packages/ai` (local predictor), `packages/i18n` (es/en/fr), `packages/ui`.
- `scripts/run-unit-tests.mjs` (test discovery), `scripts/guards/` (licence, LLM egress, hygiene, test discovery), `scripts/launch/` (deploy smokes), `e2e/specs/` (Playwright), `k8s/` (digest-pinned manifests).

## Docs

- [docs/capabilities.md](./docs/capabilities.md): capabilities with status and evidence.
- [docs/accessibility.md](./docs/accessibility.md): standards, access methods, speech and voices, first-run setup, testing.
- [docs/linguistic-framework.md](./docs/linguistic-framework.md): motor planning and core sizes, GLP, Fitzgerald Key, Spanish morphology.
- [docs/architecture.md](./docs/architecture.md): components, sync model, deploy flow.
- [docs/data-model.md](./docs/data-model.md): tables, migrations and the journal rule.
- [docs/auth/JANUA.md](./docs/auth/JANUA.md): SSO for web and API.
- [docs/deploy/ENCLII.md](./docs/deploy/ENCLII.md): deploy workflows, storage, Redis, request limits, Postgres connection budget.
- [docs/ops/RUNBOOK.md](./docs/ops/RUNBOOK.md), [docs/ops/BACKUP_RESTORE.md](./docs/ops/BACKUP_RESTORE.md): on-call and backups.
- [docs/ai-roadmap.md](./docs/ai-roadmap.md): word suggestions today and the plan.
- [docs/launch/MIGRATION.md](./docs/launch/MIGRATION.md): Open Board Format import/export and beta imports. [docs/launch/MOBILE_GA.md](./docs/launch/MOBILE_GA.md): mobile store path. [docs/launch/SLP_SIGNOFF.md](./docs/launch/SLP_SIGNOFF.md): clinical review, pending. Other files in `docs/launch/` are June 2026 launch records kept for history.
- [docs/legal/](./docs/legal/): privacy, terms and data-handling summaries.
- [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md): the October 2026 stabilization and compliance wave, grouped by theme.

## Contracts with other repositories

- Janua (identity), claims contract: https://github.com/madfam-org/janua/blob/main/docs/architecture/CLAIMS_DE_ORGANIZACION_Y_SERVICE_PRINCIPALS.md
- Janua integration: https://github.com/madfam-org/janua/blob/main/docs/guides/ECOSYSTEM_INTEGRATION.md and https://github.com/madfam-org/solarpunk-foundry/blob/main/docs/JANUA_INTEGRATION.md
- Entitlements: the Janua `voxa_tier` claim (billing writes it through Janua), described in AGENTS.md.
- Enclii (deploy): https://github.com/madfam-org/enclii/blob/main/docs/guides/ZERO_TOUCH_CONTRACT.md
- Open Board Format: https://www.openboardformat.org/docs
- Mulberry Symbols: https://github.com/mulberrysymbols/mulberry-symbols (CC BY-SA 4.0)
